title: arenaria arenarioides var. macrosperma
intro: Arenaria arenarioides var. macrosperma, commonly known as Sea Sandwort, is a perennial plant species belonging to the Caryophyllaceae family. It is native to coastal areas and has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Sea Sandwort include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can aid in reducing inflammation and protecting against cell damage. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, that have been shown to exhibit antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant activities.
